### Motivation

- Allow MCP tools to operate without an explicit `mailboxId` when only one mailbox exists and provide clearer errors when none or multiple mailboxes exist.
- Centralize mailbox resolution and verification to remove duplication and standardize behavior across all MCP tools.

### Description

- Add `workers/lib/mailbox-context.ts` implementing `resolveMailboxId` which normalizes an explicit mailbox, auto-selects a single mailbox, and throws descriptive errors for zero/multiple mailboxes.
- Update `workers/mcp/index.ts` to import `resolveMailboxId`, introduce a `resolveAndVerifyMailbox` helper, make `mailboxId` optional in zod tool schemas, and replace individual `verifyMailbox` calls with the new resolution+verification flow across all MCP tools.
- Add unit tests in `tests/mailbox-context.test.ts` covering explicit selection, single-mailbox auto-selection, and error conditions for no or multiple mailboxes.
- Add a `test` script to `package.json` to run tests with `node --import tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts`.

### Testing

- Ran unit tests via `npm test` which executed `tests/mailbox-context.test.ts`, and all tests passed.
